title: ESP32 Hardware & Serial Console
subtitle: Connect sequentially: Hardware Device ➔ Virtual Gamepad Service ➔ Switch Console

step0.title: Step 0: Verify USB Connection & ESP32 Firmware
step0.desc: Auto-detects ESP32 chips (CH340/CP210x) and verifies PRO-UART0 handshake
step0.no_device_desc: Please connect ESP32 to computer via USB data cable, then click "Rescan Devices".

flasher.title: ESP32 1-Click Firmware Flasher (PRO-UART0.bin)
flasher.subtitle: Switch Pro Controller Emulation Firmware
flasher.tip: For new boards or firmware reset, click here to write official firmware to chip.

step1.locked_no_usb: Please connect an ESP32 USB device first
step1.locked_unverified: ESP32 firmware did not pass PRO-UART0 handshake. Please verify correct firmware.
step1.title: Step 1: Virtual Gamepad Service (60Hz Streaming)
step1.desc: Establishes PC ➔ ESP32 serial communication and maintains heartbeat alive
step1.heartbeat_notice: 60Hz heartbeat enabled: prevents Switch idle sleep with 200ms watchdog auto-neutral.

step2.locked_desc: Please start Step 1 Virtual Gamepad first. Switch pairing requires active serial streaming.
step2.title: Step 2: Switch Auto-Pairing & Connection
step2.desc: Pair manually once to remember host, subsequent starts will automatically reconnect 1P

paired_box.title: Paired Console Remembered (Auto-Pair Ready)
paired_box.desc: Switch console remembered. When starting virtual gamepad, A-button wake signal is sent automatically for instant connection.

unpaired_box.title: First-time Pairing Flow (No Console Remembered)
unpaired_box.step1: 1. On Switch home screen, go to Controllers ➔ Change Grip/Order.
unpaired_box.step2: 2. Click button below to send L + R handshake pulse for 1P assignment.
unpaired_box.step3: 3. Once paired, console will be remembered for future auto-connection!

feedback.paired_success: L+R pairing sent! Switch recognized 1P and memory has been saved for future auto-connect.
feedback.wake_success: Wake pulse sent! Switch should reconnect as 1P shortly.
feedback.neutral_success: Neutral safety packet sent. All inputs reset to center.
feedback.reset_success: ESP32 Bluetooth bonds reset and local auto-pairing cleared.
feedback.need_step1_first: Please start Step 1 Virtual Gamepad Service before sending commands!
feedback.service_stopped: Virtual gamepad service stopped. All inputs reset to center.
feedback.select_port_first: Please select ESP32 serial port in Step 0 first
feedback.service_started_auto: Virtual gamepad service started! Paired console found, auto-reconnecting...
feedback.auto_wake_sent: Wake reconnect pulse sent! Switch should reconnect as 1P.
feedback.service_started_manual: Virtual gamepad service started! Please proceed to Step 2 for first-time pairing.
feedback.flash_select_port: Please connect ESP32 and select serial port first
feedback.flash_complete: PRO-UART0.bin flashed successfully! Re-verifying handshake protocol...
